searchText: are there endpoints on beacon nodes that allow people to get requesters to get merkle proofs against beaconstate roots? sorta like the CL version of eth_getProof. any advice for how to go about generating or fetching such proofs? being considered at the moment: <https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/pull/267> for Lighthouse it’s easy for us to support specific proofs to support the light client protocol, but a bit more work would be required to enable generic multi-proofs
